role: Binds every external capability to precise Lean declarations, parameter preconditions, JC authority entries, verifiers and acceptance samples. Routes and mappings are implementation-scope decisions, never proof of the runtime. No field may be filled with kernelVerified without an implementation-level proof that does not exist today.

parameter_preconditions: runScope.caseScope = caseScope (request belongs to its case)
observable_quantities: request identity fields observed on every admitted object
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: compiler_core/independent_checker.py re-derives request binding from canonical bytes
exclusions: mappingVersion agreement is an engineering obligation; no Lean theorem proves the Python projection

parameter_preconditions: partial results carry a nonempty openObligations set
observable_quantities: exactly one of complete/partial/failure per solve; failure tag and reason preserved
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker verifies result constructors against solver receipts
exclusions: timeout wrapping into success is forbidden; failure subjects must survive projection

parameter_preconditions: edge request equals graph request; endpoints within graph nodes
observable_quantities: typed node/edge kinds, request identity on every edge
exclusions: full dependency-payload refinement of node field domains remains an implementation duty (per ULM03 source); empirical nodes must never join normative outputs

parameter_preconditions: VerifierSound assumed for the concrete verifier; obligations nonempty by construction
observable_quantities: per-edge obligation set; verifier acceptance evidence
exclusions: sat_sound presumes VerifierSound; Python checker reliability is engineering-verified, not Lean-verified

parameter_preconditions: transitions are edge and finalize only
observable_quantities: phase progression, edge completion, terminal states
exclusions: concurrency, crash recovery and scheduler termination are engineering acceptance items, not covered by ULM05 theorems

parameter_preconditions: admitted tokens carry a matching FactAdmissionAttestation; assumed tokens carry a request-bound witness
observable_quantities: premise origin, dependency sets per derivation
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker re-verifies attestation binding and expiry/revocation
exclusions: admitted-zero-assumption does not mean reality is proved; disputes must not be upgraded by generators

parameter_preconditions: every atom in universe carries the system request
observable_quantities: least support closure per request; candidate positions
capability_mappings.applicable_profile: all profiles (support layer, never final adjudication)
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker re-runs its own Horn analysis from immutable bytes
exclusions: CandidateWF does not prove the candidate claim follows from its support; claim-root witness via ULM08 is required

parameter_preconditions: ArgumentCoverage compares actual against an independently produced expected carrier; expected must itself be well formed
observable_quantities: argument identity as full labelled support hypergraph; AND/OR routes
jc_authority_entry: work reference constructor registered as the only expected producer
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker compares against the frozen reference, never generator self-output
exclusions: no self-comparison of actual to generator-copied expected; cyclic concrete derivations stay rejected

parameter_preconditions: attack witness nonempty; attacker and target share the request; defeat policy frozen and evidence-bound
observable_quantities: seven attack kinds; resolved defeat relation entering Dung layer
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker re-derives attacks and defeat edges from inputs
exclusions: DefeatPolicy is a frozen legal policy decision; Lean proves binding of resolved edges, not the policy content; priority alone must not manufacture attacks

parameter_preconditions: defeat AF well formed; powerset reference families are noncomputable references
capability_mappings.applicable_profile: grounded default; others on explicit request with enumeration budget
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker recomputes grounded; bounded reference enumeration verified for others
exclusions: NoExtension/{empty extension}/incomplete are distinct; maximality of partial preferred sets must be verified before verification claims

parameter_preconditions: query gate enterable requires a positive witness; empty families forbid vacuous Common
observable_quantities: per-branch query statuses with witnesses; refutation direction
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker re-derives query witnesses from the extension family
exclusions: argument OUT does not imply claim refutation; refutation is directed, never symmetric by default

parameter_preconditions: ValidFor requires issue match, request-bound consequences, nonempty reviewer and nonprocedural consequences; reviewer authorization is verified by engineering, not by the model string
observable_quantities: four-way procedure output; frozen decision table
capability_mappings.applicable_profile: only when request asks for procedure/burden consequences
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker validates authority references and decision table output
exclusions: NoExtension never implies losing; incomplete solves never produce terminal outcomes; actual remedies come from admitted rules, not hardcoded names

parameter_preconditions: candidates share one branch and request; selection is a nonempty policy-allowed subset; dimensions are type-level
observable_quantities: child branch keys; exact rational evaluation
capability_mappings.applicable_profile: only when domain composition or exact arithmetic is requested
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker re-evaluates expressions with independent arithmetic
exclusions: eval=denote proves interpreter correctness, not statutory policy choice; only lit/add/sub/scale are covered - other operations keep their existing numeric contracts

parameter_preconditions: same scope required for combination; every field aggregates by its own conservative rule
observable_quantities: assurance fields per run; kept assumption/pending/exempt evidence
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker refuses assurance upgrades and pseudo-exemptions
exclusions: kernelVerified is never granted by default; notApplicable needs verified applicability evidence

parameter_preconditions: add-only deltas keep the universe fixed; IncrementalImplementationCorrect is a premise, not an observed fact; Banach guarantees need a declared complete space, a map with global contraction and an error bound
observable_quantities: incremental equality to full recompute; read-only empirical artifacts
capability_mappings.applicable_profile: Horn add-only fast path off by default until benchmarked; empirical channel read-only
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker compares against full recomputation; empirical perturbation must not move normative digests
exclusions: sample fitting is never a contraction proof; without a verified model reference no probability estimate is returned; downstream Dung/procedure layers still recompute

parameter_preconditions: named theorems are concrete normal-form instances; ownership maps bind CORE/COMP ids to ULM modules
observable_quantities: composition index bound to real call edges through this map
capability_mappings.independent_verifier: independent_checker + acceptance suite JT02/JT03 subject binding
exclusions: the existence of CORE/COMP indices does not close every theorem family; Python refinement claims stay per-obligation
